load_model_from_checkpoint: load a ManifoldFM model from a PyTorch checkpoint file with optional solver tolerance overrides
get_job_directory_from_checkpoint: get the Hydra job directory path from a checkpoint file path or checkpoint dictionary
load_model_with_eval_projx: load a ManifoldFM model from checkpoint and override the eval_projx config setting
load_model_with_tolerances: load a ManifoldFM model from checkpoint with custom atol and rtol solver tolerance values
review_load_model: review the load_model function that loads a ManifoldFMLitModule from a checkpoint and Hydra config
